sovereignAI.sup: If you are new to the term
sovereignAI.headline: What is sovereign AI
sovereignAI.p1Before: Sovereign AI is AI that runs
sovereignAI.p1After: , under the institution's own governance, not in a vendor's cloud.
sovereignAI.p2: Most platforms calling themselves "sovereign AI" today are hosted services with European billing addresses. The data still crosses the vendor's network, the inference still runs on the vendor's hardware, and the audit trail still belongs to the vendor. That is regulatory residency, not operational sovereignty.
sovereignAI.p3: Davion is operationally sovereign: deployments run inside the customer's perimeter, air-gapped, on-prem, or in a sovereign cloud bound by contract. The data does not leave. The weights are auditable on-prem. Every decision traces back to the source it was made on.

why.p1: The category has confused regulatory residency with operational sovereignty.
why.p2: Most platforms calling themselves "sovereign AI" today are hosted services with European billing addresses. The data crosses the vendor's network. The inference runs on the vendor's hardware. The audit trail lives in the vendor's cloud. The contract says "sovereign" because the postcode is European.
why.p3: For banks, ministries, and operators of critical infrastructure, that is not sovereignty. It is procurement theatre. The data is still leaving. The decisions are still being made somewhere the operator doesn't control. The audit trail still belongs to the vendor.
why.p4Before: Davion exists because the gap between
why.p4After: is the gap between a platform a defense ministry can use and a platform it cannot. We build for the second.
why.p5: Our deployments run inside the customer's perimeter. The data does not leave. The weights are auditable on-prem. The inference runs where the work runs, air-gapped, on-prem, or in a sovereign cloud bound by contract. Every decision is traceable to the data it was made on, the policy it applied, and the version of the model that produced it.
why.p6: This is not marketing copy. It is the operational difference between a platform that can be used and one that cannot.

believe.headline: Five claims we will defend in public
believe.body: Every product decision Davion makes traces back to one of these. If you read them and disagree, we're probably not the right vendor, and that's a useful thing to learn early.
believe.c01t: Sovereignty is where the work happens
believe.c01b: Regulatory residency is not sovereignty. Hosted AI with a European postcode is not sovereignty. Sovereignty is determined by where the data lives, where the weights are stored, and where the inference runs. Davion runs where the work runs.
believe.c02t: A decision is only defensible when it can be reconstructed
believe.c02b: AI without an audit trail is not AI an institution can use. Every output Davion produces points back to the data it was made on, the policy it applied, and the version of the model that produced it. If a regulator asks "why", the platform has an answer.
believe.c03t: The hard cases are not edge cases
believe.c03b: Air-gapped. On-prem. Inside a perimeter you control. These are not exceptions to the category, they are the operational reality of every institution where decisions actually matter. We design for the hard case first; the easier deployments are downstream.
believe.c04b: Davion is composable end to end and replaceable end to end. Ingestion, ontology, analytics, agentic layer, action, each is replaceable. We intend to be a vendor you can leave. That is how vendors who deserve to stay get to stay.
believe.c05t: The operator runs the system. We do not run the decisions.
believe.c05b: Davion is a platform, not an autonomous agent. The decisions belong to the people accountable for them: the analyst, the compliance officer, the operator, the commander. The platform proposes, cites its sources, and waits for approval. We do not move money. We do not move people. We do not move troops.

work.p1: We listen first, to your data architecture, your regulatory constraints, your operational reality, the decisions you actually need to defend. The first conversation is consultative; if Davion isn't the right answer, we will say so.
work.p2: Most engagements start with a 6 to 12 week pilot scoped against a specific, measurable outcome, typically a single decision class (e.g. AML alert triage, anomaly detection on operational telemetry, OSINT brief generation). The deliverable is a working deployment inside your perimeter, plus the operational evidence to decide whether to expand.

hero.headlinePart1: Sovereign AI infrastructure for decisions that can't wait
hero.body: Most organisations can see their data. Few can act on it when it matters. AlpOS closes the gap, one governed environment, from every source to every decision, inside your perimeter.

problem.headline: When data outpaces the capacity to decide, decisions fail
problem.body: Institutions today inherit fragmented data, opaque models, and tooling that was not built to be governed. The cost is not abstract, it is missed signals, slow responses, and decisions that cannot be defended after the fact. AlpOS exists to close that gap.

architecture.svgAria: AlpOS architecture: Ingest, Ontology, Analyze and AI, Decide, Act, all inside a sovereign perimeter.

layers.headline: Five layers. One spine. Designed to be governed

l1.title: Data integration & preparation
l1.body: Pull every relevant signal, structured, unstructured, real-time, archival, through a single governed pipeline. Native connectors, schema-on-read or schema-on-write, lineage tracked from source. Nothing is collected blindly. Nothing is collected outside policy.

l2.title: Semantic model of your domain
l2.body: Entities, events, and relationships modeled to your domain, not a generic schema. The ontology becomes the shared vocabulary across analysts, engineers, and operators. Queries and AI reason against it, not against raw tables.

l3.title: Analytics, knowledge graphs, weak-signal detection
l3.body: Run the analytic load where the data lives. Knowledge graphs surface relationships flat queries miss. Statistical and ML methods detect the patterns, and the weak signals that precede them.

l4.title: AI copilot with traceability
l4.body: An agentic copilot that argues from the ontology, cites the data, and shows its work. Every recommendation is traceable to its source. Hallucinations do not survive contact with auditable evidence.

l5.title: Operational decisioning & workflow
l5.body: Decisions only matter when they reach the operator and the system. Workflows, dispatch, case management, and write-back to systems of record are embedded, so AlpOS does not stop at insight.

field.headline: Three institutions. Three problems. One platform
field.body: How AlpOS is applied in practice, three concrete deployments across financial services, critical infrastructure, and defense.

s1.problem: Financial crime rarely leaves a single trace.
s1.body: AlpOS maps the full network of entities, accounts, transactions, and behavioural signals across sources, surfacing the patterns flat rules and isolated dashboards miss. Investigations move from alerts to actionable cases, with full lineage from raw transaction to operator decision.
s1.outcome: Faster case adjudication. Fewer false positives. Audit by design.

s2.problem: Fleet-wide defects, hidden in the variance.
s2.body: AlpOS correlates telemetry across distributed assets, finds the weak signals that precede failure, and routes the response to the operators who can act, without telemetry leaving the perimeter. The same spine handles unplanned outages and planned maintenance windows.
s2.outcome: Anomaly response in minutes. Defensible runbooks. Post-incident review without losing the institution.

s3.problem: Decisions in classified environments cannot wait, and cannot leak.
s3.body: AlpOS unifies signal streams inside the perimeter, lets analysts pivot across them with cited evidence, and produces traceable outputs the after-action can defend. Deployable on-premise and air-gapped, with cell-level access control and a full audit trail.
s3.outcome: Mission cycle compressed. Every action defensible.

sovereign.headline: Your data. Your jurisdiction. Your access controls. Your audit
sovereign.body: Sovereignty is not a deployment option. It is an architectural commitment. AlpOS runs where you require, and only where you require.
sovereign.m1Body: Your hardware. Your network. Your operational control. AlpOS is installable inside your perimeter with no external dependencies at runtime.
sovereign.m2Body: Disconnected operation for environments that require it. Signed-update model; nothing transits unsanctioned channels.
sovereign.m3Body: Run inside a sovereign cloud you trust, in the region you require, under contracts that bind data jurisdiction.
sovereign.m4Body: Single-tenant deployment in a cloud of your choice, with customer-managed keys and per-tenant isolation.

modular.headline: Compose the platform. Brand the modules
modular.body: AlpOS layers are independently deployable and independently brandable. Customers and partners map their own product names onto the same architecture, under the same sovereignty guarantees. The platform is the constant. The surface is yours.

phases.p4Body: Train operators, hand off ownership, and instrument the platform for ongoing change. The work continues, without the contractor.

underneath.l3Body: Replace report-and-meeting cycles with operator-grade decisioning, with AI that cites its sources.
underneath.l4Body: Write decisions back to the systems of record the institution already runs.
